name: anim_jyu_slam_sway5
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Loop: facing straight toward the viewer with both hands on his hips, he lewdly grinds his hips in a very slow, heavy, sticky circle, as if rubbing them against something: the hips roll out far to his left and he lingers there, sinking even lower and giving a small extra push, then they drag slowly around through the center and far out to his right where he lingers and sinks again, then roll back to the center. His whole body follows the grind: the upper body turns toward each side so one shoulder comes forward, the knees bend deeply at each side and the body rises in the middle, and the head tilts with the body while he keeps looking down at the viewer with a heavy, smug, leering gaze. The big belly and chest lag behind the hips and sag and wobble heavily like thick, gooey liquid. Every motion is extremely slow, smooth and syrupy, easing in and out. The face keeps exactly the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
